Package com.signalwire.sdk.swaig

Class FunctionResult

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.swaig.FunctionResult
public class FunctionResult extends Object
SwaigFunctionResult - the response builder returned by tool handlers.

Every method returns this for fluent chaining. Contains 40+ action methods covering call control, state management, media, speech/AI config, and advanced features.

Serialization rules:

  • response - always included (string)
  • action - only included if at least one action exists (array of objects)
  • post_process - only included if true and actions exist (boolean)

    • recordCall

      public FunctionResult recordCall(String controlId, boolean stereo, String format, String direction, String terminators, boolean beep, double inputSensitivity, Double initialTimeout, Double endSilenceTimeout, Double maxLength, String statusUrl)
      Start background call recording via SWML — full parity with the Python reference signalwire.core.function_result.FunctionResult.record_call.

      Validates format ∈ {wav, mp3, mp4} and direction ∈ {speak, listen, both} with byte-exact Python ValueError messages. The reference ALWAYS emits stereo, format, direction, beep and input_sensitivity; control_id, terminators, initial_timeout, end_silence_timeout, max_length and status_url are emitted only when supplied.

      Parameters:
      controlId - recording identifier (pairs with stopRecordCall; null to omit)
      stereo - record in stereo (default false)
      format - "wav", "mp3" or "mp4" (default "wav")
      direction - "speak", "listen" or "both" (default "both")
      terminators - digits that stop recording (null to omit)
      beep - play a beep before recording (default false; ALWAYS emitted)
      inputSensitivity - input sensitivity (default 44.0; ALWAYS emitted)
      initialTimeout - seconds to wait for speech start (null to omit)
      endSilenceTimeout - seconds of trailing silence before ending (null to omit)
      maxLength - maximum recording length in seconds (null to omit)
      statusUrl - URL for recording status events (null to omit)
      Returns:
      this, for chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if format or direction is invalid

    • recordCall

      public FunctionResult recordCall(String controlId, boolean stereo, RecordFormat format, RecordDirection direction, String terminators, boolean beep, double inputSensitivity, Double initialTimeout, Double endSilenceTimeout, Double maxLength, String statusUrl)
      Fully-typed, full-arity overload of recordCall(String, boolean, String, String, String, boolean, double, Double, Double, Double, String): the closed-set format (RecordFormat) and direction (RecordDirection) are typed so a misspelled container format or direction fails at compile time instead of being rejected by the server's ValueError, while every Python record_call optional (terminators / beep / input_sensitivity / initial_timeout / end_silence_timeout / max_length / status_url) is still exposed positionally. Delegates to the string path via RecordFormat.getValue() / RecordDirection.getValue(), so the emitted SWML record_call payload is byte-identical to the bare-string call. This is the canonical reference-parity surface; the all-String full-arity overload above is the forward-compatible escape hatch (and the convenience/typed lower-arity overloads below just delegate here).

    • joinConference

      public FunctionResult joinConference(String name, boolean muted, String beep, boolean startOnEnter, boolean endOnExit, String waitUrl, int maxParticipants, String record, String region, String trim, String coach, String statusCallbackEvent, String statusCallback, String statusCallbackMethod, String recordingStatusCallback, String recordingStatusCallbackMethod, String recordingStatusCallbackEvent, Object result)
      Join an ad-hoc audio conference with RELAY and CXML calls using SWML.

      Functional parity with the Python reference signalwire.core.function_result.FunctionResult.join_conference. Every optional parameter the reference exposes is a positional argument here, with the same default and the same validation. Hold music is waitUrl (snake_case wire key wait_url) — there is no separate "hold audio" parameter; the reference uses wait_url.

      Parameters:
      name - conference name (required, must be non-blank)
      muted - join muted (default false)
      beep - "true", "false", "onEnter", "onExit" (default "true")
      startOnEnter - conference starts when this participant enters (default true)
      endOnExit - conference ends when this participant exits (default false)
      waitUrl - SWML URL for hold music (null for default)
      maxParticipants - maximum participants, 1..250 (default 250)
      record - "do-not-record" or "record-from-start" (default "do-not-record")
      region - conference region (null for default)
      trim - "trim-silence" or "do-not-trim" (default "trim-silence")
      coach - SWML Call ID / CXML CallSid for coaching (null for none)
      statusCallbackEvent - space-separated status events (null for none)
      statusCallback - URL for status callbacks (null for none)
      statusCallbackMethod - "GET" or "POST" (default "POST")
      recordingStatusCallback - URL for recording status callbacks (null for none)
      recordingStatusCallbackMethod - "GET" or "POST" (default "POST")
      recordingStatusCallbackEvent - recording events (default "completed")
      result - switch-on-return value/cond (null for none)
      Returns:
      this, for chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any validated value is invalid

    • tap

      public FunctionResult tap(String uri, String controlId, String direction, String codec, int rtpPtime, String statusUrl)
      Start a background call tap via SWML — full parity with the Python reference signalwire.core.function_result.FunctionResult.tap.

      Validates direction ∈ {speak, hear, both}, codec ∈ {PCMU, PCMA}, and rtp_ptime > 0 with byte-exact Python ValueError messages (rendered through IllegalArgumentException). Only uri is always emitted; each other key is emitted only when it differs from its reference default (direction != "both", codec != "PCMU", rtp_ptime != 20), plus control_id and status_url when supplied.

      Parameters:
      uri - tap media-stream destination (required; rtp://, ws://, wss://)
      controlId - tap identifier (null for an auto-generated one)
      direction - "speak", "hear" or "both" (default "both")
      codec - "PCMU" or "PCMA" (default "PCMU")
      rtpPtime - RTP packetization time in ms, > 0 (default 20)
      statusUrl - URL for status-change requests (null to omit)
      Returns:
      this, for chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if direction, codec or rtp_ptime is invalid

    • tap

      public FunctionResult tap(String uri, String controlId, TapDirection direction, Codec codec, int rtpPtime, String statusUrl)
      Fully-typed, full-arity overload of tap(String, String, String, String, int, String): the closed-set direction (TapDirection) and codec (Codec) are typed so a misspelled direction or codec fails at compile time instead of being rejected by the server's ValueError, while the remaining Python tap params (rtp_ptime / status_url) are still exposed positionally. Delegates to the string path via TapDirection.getValue() / Codec.getValue(), so the emitted SWML tap payload is byte-identical to the bare-string call. This is the canonical reference-parity surface; the all-String full-arity overload above is the forward-compatible escape hatch (and the convenience/typed lower-arity overloads below just delegate here).

      Parameters:
      toNumber - E.164 destination (required)
      fromNumber - E.164 origin (required)
      body - message body (null if media supplied)
      media - media URLs (null if body supplied)
      tags - tags for UI search (null to omit)
      region - region to originate the message from (null to omit)
      Returns:
      this, for chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if neither body nor media is provided

    • pay

      public FunctionResult pay(String connectorUrl, String inputMethod, String statusUrl, String paymentMethod, int timeout, int maxAttempts, boolean securityCode, Object postalCode, int minPostalCodeLength, String tokenType, String chargeAmount, String currency, String language, String voice, String description, String validCardTypes, List<Map<String,String>> parameters, List<Map<String,Object>> prompts, String aiResponse)
      Process payment via SWML pay action — full parity with the Python reference signalwire.core.function_result.FunctionResult.pay.

      Every optional parameter the reference exposes is a positional argument here, in the same order, with the same default and the same emitted wire key. The reference ALWAYS emits payment_connector_url, input, payment_method, timeout, max_attempts, security_code, min_postal_code_length, token_type, currency, language, voice, valid_card_types and postal_code; status_url, charge_amount, description, parameters and prompts are emitted only when supplied. Numeric values are stringified to match Python's str(...). A set verb carrying ai_response is emitted before the pay verb.

      Parameters:
      connectorUrl - payment connector URL (required)
      inputMethod - "dtmf" (the SWML schema is const:"dtmf"; default "dtmf")
      statusUrl - URL for status-change notifications (null to omit)
      paymentMethod - payment method (default "credit-card")
      timeout - seconds to wait for next digit (default 5)
      maxAttempts - retry attempts (default 1)
      securityCode - prompt for the security code (default true)
      postalCode - prompt for postal code (Boolean) or the literal postcode (String); default Boolean.TRUE
      minPostalCodeLength - minimum postal-code digits (default 0)
      tokenType - "one-time" or "reusable" (default "reusable")
      chargeAmount - amount to charge, decimal string (null to omit)
      currency - currency code (default "usd")
      language - prompt language (default "en-US")
      voice - TTS voice (default "woman")
      description - custom payment description (null to omit)
      validCardTypes - space-separated card types (default "visa mastercard amex")
      parameters - name/value pairs for the connector (null to omit)
      prompts - custom prompt configurations (null to omit)
      aiResponse - ai_response text for the leading set verb (default DEFAULT_PAY_AI_RESPONSE)
      Returns:
      this, for chaining
